newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian president names new finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian president names new finance minister.

text.p: Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas on Wednesday said he has signed a decree appointing Algirdas Shemeta as new finance minister.
Shemeta is currently the head of the securities commission and replaces Rolandas Matiliauskas, who resigned in late January amid a scandal over a bank loan.
"I appoint Algirdas Gediminas Shemeta as finance minister. This decree comes into effect from the date of its signing," Brazauskas said in a decree issued by the president's office.

Shemeta, 34, is a trained mathematician and economist and becomes finance minister as right-wing Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius tries to speed up privatisation and attract more foreign investment.

The country also plans gradually to phase out its currency board system of pegging the litas currency at four to one dollar. It says it will keep the fixed exchange rate but manage it without the currency board.
